# DCC-MCP OBS

Native OBS Studio control product: https://github.com/dcc-mcp/dcc-mcp-obs

- Use the bundled `obs-control` skill for OBS recording, scene/source
  inspection, pause/resume, 录屏, and 录制视频 requests.
- Typed scene switching, scene-item CRUD, transitions, and Studio Mode preview/program operations are available through the native contract.
- The built-in DCC-MCP Agent Input source can be shared across demo scenes and displays only Agent-emitted shortcut, mouse, wheel, or typing-count cues; it never captures global input or arbitrary text.
- Search and load the skill before calling tools.
- Native plugin/WebSocket tools are authoritative; no raw request or script tool exists.
- Every state mutation requires typed readback and exact instance identity.
- Use request_graceful_shutdown for a terminal normal exit; it refuses active
  outputs and never claims in-band process-exit verification.
- The OBS password is operator-owned and must never be requested or emitted.
- DCC-CUA is a scoped fallback only for unsupported visual UI actions with exact
  PID/HWND, fresh snapshot, and post-action readback. No generic Computer Use fallback.
- Tests and CI are not real-OBS acceptance.
